# docker_compose_volumes (Data Source)

Lists the volumes of a compose project, like `docker compose volumes`, by the `com.docker.compose.project` label.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_compose_volumes" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "volume_names" {
  value = data.docker_compose_volumes.shop.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`).

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of `volumes_json`.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon.
- `names` (List of String) The volume names, sorted.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The project's volumes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))
- `volumes_json` (String) JSON array of the project's Volume objects (GET /volumes, project label filter).

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_volume` (String) Upstream `ClusterVolume`. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, snake_case): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
- `created_at` (String) Upstream `CreatedAt`.
- `driver` (String) Upstream `Driver`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Upstream `Labels`.
- `mountpoint` (String) Upstream `Mountpoint`.
- `name` (String) Upstream `Name`.
- `options` (Map of String) Upstream `Options`.
- `scope` (String) Upstream `Scope`.
- `status` (Map of String) Upstream `Status`.
- `usage_data` (String) Upstream `UsageData`. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, snake_case): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
